# Governor/capital finder tooltip status line: names rank 2/3 or a local maximum. Appended to
# the scored tooltip via [ROOT.GetLocation.Custom('bcm_pf_gf_status' / 'bcm_pf_cf_status')].
bcm_pf_gf_status = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = bcm_gf_top  # check-script: never set — written through a macro, as bcm_$M$_top in bcm_pf_rank_top
			var:bcm_gf_top = 2  # check-script: never set — written through a macro, as bcm_$M$_top in bcm_pf_rank_top
		}
		localization_key = bcm_pf_status_second
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = bcm_gf_top  # check-script: never set — written through a macro, as bcm_$M$_top in bcm_pf_rank_top
			var:bcm_gf_top = 3  # check-script: never set — written through a macro, as bcm_$M$_top in bcm_pf_rank_top
		}
		localization_key = bcm_pf_status_third
	}
	text = {
		# Skip capital/governor tiles: they show their own stripes, not the gray local-max one.
		trigger = {
			has_variable = bcm_gf_localmax
			NOT = { modifier:local_proximity_source > 0 }
		}
		localization_key = bcm_pf_status_localmax
	}
}

bcm_pf_cf_status = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = bcm_cf_top  # check-script: never set — written through a macro, as bcm_$M$_top in bcm_pf_rank_top
			var:bcm_cf_top = 2  # check-script: never set — written through a macro, as bcm_$M$_top in bcm_pf_rank_top
		}
		localization_key = bcm_pf_status_second
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = bcm_cf_top  # check-script: never set — written through a macro, as bcm_$M$_top in bcm_pf_rank_top
			var:bcm_cf_top = 3  # check-script: never set — written through a macro, as bcm_$M$_top in bcm_pf_rank_top
		}
		localization_key = bcm_pf_status_third
	}
	text = {
		# Skip source tiles: they show the magenta stripe, not the gray local-max one.
		trigger = {
			has_variable = bcm_cf_localmax
			NOT = { modifier:local_proximity_source > 0 }
		}
		localization_key = bcm_pf_status_localmax
	}
}

# Debug label for the predicted-proximity line in BCM_PF_DEBUG_BLOCK, matching the roads setting
# the predicted value was computed under.
bcm_pf_pred_label = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			owner = { bcm_pf_roads_is_current = yes }
		}
		localization_key = bcm_pf_pred_label_current
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = bcm_pf_pred_label_max
	}
}

# Basis wording for the governor no-gain tooltip, matching the infrastructure settings the
# run was computed under.
bcm_pf_nogain_basis = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			owner = {
				bcm_pf_roads_is_current = yes
				bcm_pf_naval_is_current_presence = yes
			}
		}
		localization_key = bcm_pf_nogain_basis_current
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = bcm_pf_nogain_basis_assumed
	}
}

# Which of the two ways a location can host neither governor type the ineligible tooltip names.
bcm_pf_inelig_reason = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			bcm_gov_site_blocks_land_governor = yes
		}
		localization_key = bcm_pf_inelig_reason_blocked
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = bcm_pf_inelig_reason_route
	}
}

# Gates the entire --debug-- block behind the diagnostic setting: with it off, the debug-mode
# tooltip matches the plain one.
bcm_pf_debug_block = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			owner = { exists = var:bcm_placement_finder_debug_path }  # check-script: never set — a CMF setting. There is no settings page here; the exists check falls through to the default
		}
		localization_key = bcm_pf_debug_block_text
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = bcm_pf_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}

# Debug path from the capital, shown at the bottom of the debug block. Custom loc cannot iterate,
# so the path is a fixed set of slots read off the hovered location's bcm_pf_prev chain: slot k shows
# the node k-1 hops up the chain, gated on bcm_pf_dep (its hop count from the capital). bcm_pf_path_body
# concatenates them highest-depth-first so the capital leads; unfilled slots emit nothing.
bcm_pf_path_block = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = bcm_pf_prev }
		localization_key = bcm_pf_path_body
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = bcm_pf_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}

bcm_pf_path_overflow = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = { var:bcm_pf_dep >= 12 }
		localization_key = bcm_pf_path_overflow_line
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = bcm_pf_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}
